title: Move the task list into the repo
item: Move the task list from the Google Sheet into the repo: one file per task, a lint, a table view and a next-task picker
motivation: The sheet was six rows behind the repo on 2026-11-15; a status changed in the same commit as the work cannot fall behind
done_means: One file per task for all 33 seed tasks; every seed field reads back equal; the lint passes; the table view and the next-task picker work.

decided_for_you.chosen: one JSON file per task, tasks/<id>.json with the id zero-padded to 3
decided_for_you.rejected: Markdown with YAML front matter: the repo's scripts are stdlib-only and Python's standard library has no YAML parser
decided_for_you.would_change: the owner wanting to read and edit tasks as Markdown rather than through tasks.py list

decided_for_you.rejected: a folder inside the manager skill
decided_for_you.would_change: the task list becoming specific to one skill

decided_for_you.chosen: tasks.py next counts direct dependents, hard and soft, among tasks not Done or Dropped
decided_for_you.rejected: counting hard dependents only, or dependents of dependents
decided_for_you.would_change: the owner reading 'depend on' as hard only

decided_for_you.chosen: lint also requires finished to be set exactly when a task is Done or Dropped, the file name to equal the id, and a parked question on every Needs you task
decided_for_you.rejected: checking only the rules the prompt lists
decided_for_you.would_change: a seed or owner task that legitimately breaks one of them

decided_for_you.chosen: the parked question (needs_you) and the decided-for-you records live as optional fields in the task file
decided_for_you.would_change: the records growing too long to read in one JSON file

decided_for_you.chosen: tokens is null or {agents, main_session}, with main_session "not recorded"
